summary: Iteration 103: Multi-Level Approval Workflow - All backend (26/26) and frontend tests passed. Backend: Full approval chain (draft→submitted→category_approved→senior_approved→head_approved→ordered), reject/request_changes with comment validation, approval history endpoint. Frontend: Approval workflow panel, 6-stage timeline, action buttons based on status, history modal with action timeline, rejection banner.

TEST_07_reject_with_comment.notes: action=reject with comment moves to rejected

TEST_09_request_changes_with_comment.notes: action=request_changes with comment moves back to draft

TEST_13_approval_history.notes: GET /api/buy-planning/buy-plans/{id}/approval-history returns ordered list with action, from_status, to_status, performed_by, performed_at

TEST_14_approval_history_empty_for_new_p.notes: New plan has empty approval history

TEST_15_get_plan_returns_approval_fields.notes: GET plan returns approvals, submitted_at/by, category_approved_at/by, etc.

TEST_17_backward_compat_approve_endpoint.notes: Old POST /approve endpoint still works, sets status to ordered

TEST_28_approval_timeline_visible.notes: data-testid=approval-timeline shows 6 stages (Draft, Submitted, Category, Senior, Head, Ordered)

TEST_33_reject_button.notes: Reject button visible with red styling

TEST_34_request_changes_button.notes: Request Changes button visible with amber styling

TEST_35_status_badge_draft.notes: data-testid=plan-status-badge shows DRAFT with amber styling

TEST_36_status_badge_submitted.notes: Status badge shows SUBMITTED with blue styling

TEST_37_status_badge_category_approved.notes: Status badge shows CATEGORY APPROVED with cyan styling

TEST_38_status_badge_rejected.notes: Status badge shows REJECTED with red styling

TEST_41_history_shows_actions.notes: History modal shows action name, from→to status, user, timestamp

TEST_42_rejection_banner.notes: Rejected plan shows red banner with rejection reason and user

issues: Minor: React hydration warning about <span> inside <option> - cosmetic only, doesn't affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: - APPROVAL_ACTIONS dict defines valid transitions: submit, approve_category, approve_senior, approve_head, finance_ack, reject, request_changes
- APPROVAL_ROLES dict defines which roles can perform each action (super_admin can do all)
- Status chain: draft → submitted → category_approved → senior_approved → head_approved → ordered
- Approval audit trail stored in buy_planning_approval_audit collection
- GET /api/buy-planning/buy-plans/{id} returns approval timestamps and approvals object
- Old /approve endpoint preserved for backward compatibility (auto-advances to ordered)
- Approval workflow panel (approval-workflow-panel) visible for non-ordered/non-rejected plans
- Action buttons change based on current status (approval-action-{action})
- Status badge (plan-status-badge) with color coding per status
- History modal shows action timeline with from→to status, user, timestamp
- Rejected plans show red banner with rejection reason
seed_data_creation: Multiple test buy plans created during testing. Some plans progressed through approval workflow, some rejected.
